phase_a_exact_pyzx.limitation: Exact graph rewrites and exact-basis extraction were used; the full 62-qubit independent equality verifier did not finish within a bounded observation window.

phase_b_clifford_residual.limitation: The nullity statistic is a heuristic screening proxy, not a CAMPS/OFD theorem.

phase_c_split_cutoff.limitation: The local adaptive unswap pulse was verified operationally on P5 and P6 smoke/bounded runs, but the high-search P5 calibration was stopped at 182/902 gates and the P6 bounded run stalled at 26/2,593 gates after the first pulse. It is not promoted as a solution; no P9 full same-controller correctness run is claimed.

phase_e_secondary_diagnostics.limitation: The official-style TNO core completed 100- and 250-event prefixes, but 500-event runs reached bond 16 and became too slow for the local safe bound. No quantum Tsim or Stim implementation is available; PyZX rank-width graphs are 29,988–101,898 vertices and the available greedy implementation was not launched unbounded.

final_recommendation: Run a bounded answer-blind ZX/Tsim-style contraction screen on a machine with suitable tooling, beginning with P5/P9 controls and short P6 prefixes.
